[GENERATED IMPLEMENTATION]
import Lean.Meta.Tactic.Simp
open String

def implementation (string: String) : Nat :=
let string_idx := {i: Nat | i < string.length}.toFinset
let characters := string_idx.image (fun i => string.toList.get! i)
let lowercase_characters := characters.image (fun c => c.toLower)
lowercase_characters.card
[END]
[HELPER LEMMAS]
-- No additional helper lemmas needed for this implementation
[END]
[PROOF]
by
  unfold problem_spec
  let result := implementation string
  use result
  simp [result]
  simp [implementation]

  simp [lowercase_characters.card]
